tasks.label: Zip project
tasks.command: powershell -NoProfile -Command "$root = 'C:\Project\farmer-friendly-redesign'; $zip = 'C:\Project\farmer-friendly-redesign.zip'; $exclude = @('node_modules','dist','.git'); $items = Get-ChildItem -Path $root -Force | Where-Object { $_.Name -notin $exclude }; if (Test-Path $zip) { Remove-Item $zip -Force }; Compress-Archive -Path $items.FullName -DestinationPath $zip -Force; Get-Item $zip | Select-Object FullName, Length"
